title: docs(pm): fold the SKILL.md serial chain — lane consolidation, lane job descriptions, request cards, foreign-gate parking, family dispatch
body:
Fixes #9854
Fixes #9871
Fixes #9852
Fixes #9776
Fixes #9663

**Family dispatch — five ruled cards, one branch, per-card commits.** First live run of the mechanism that the fifth member itself legalizes (maintainer fold order, verbatim: 「开始折叠派发」; fold authority: 「SKILL.md 串行链 为什么不能合并成一个卡伐」). Every member carries a claim comment naming this branch; each lands as its own commit. Governed surface — this PR stays **draft**; the maintainer merges.

### Per-commit map (commit order = member order)

| commit | card | delivers |
|---|---|---|
| 3f64a39e9 | 9854 | Domain-lane table merge: engine-core + metadata + drivers rows collapse into one `domain:engine` row (package families verbatim; the 2026-08-05 investment-freeze note rides its packages); identity's four plugins fold into the `domain:services` row; the four retired labels are marked retired IN the table (label objects stay). Companion roster sync in `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` — its own header mandates "keep both in sync BY PR whenever a lane is added or retired", and it records that `domain:engine` re-enters circulation after its own earlier retirement. Stale-lane-name sweep: one hit (the metadata-from-engine-core secondary-split sentence in the spec intra-seat reference) rewritten; `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and all other pm-dispatch references: zero hits. |
| c7683ca6b | 9871 | Six lane job descriptions in `references/lanes/` (engine, services, cli, devx, skills, spec), each 范围 + 常设承诺 + 席内判断, migrated from the live seat posts' prose, self-contained (id-lint auto-covers them). Seat-post template shrinks 6 → 4 sections in SKILL.md 座位贴协议 and `references/seat-post-protocol.md`; a post points at its lane file; live seat-post bodies deliberately untouched (migration is seat work). CEILINGS entries at landed counts + a self-test case. |
| 22ba7c211 | 9852 | Request-card protocol on the 跨座位转移 clause: a cross-seat ask of any kind (a reading, a card-opening obligation, an access need) is work and lands as a card in the target lane's queue with provenance + a one-line executable criterion; a seat-post knock or ruling comment is never the only carrier; the waiting card flips `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` at the request card in the same stroke; unreachable target repo routes via the seam-card rule (`repo:` label + named reader). No new labels, no new sweep. |
| 684466cd0 | 9776 | Done-but-unlandable state, on the `pm:blocked` row directly adjacent to the 放行双查 discharge rules: no new label; `Blocked-by:` at the gate card plus a machine-readable `Unlock-action: re-check PR` body line that swaps the unlock action from re-queue-for-work to re-check-the-PR; the re-queue premise check treats an existing finished open PR as landing work; the parked PR must name the gate card in its own body. |
| 7371c47c5 | 9663 | 批次独立性 absorbs the family-dispatch scope clarification: one dev covering N same-region ruled cards satisfies the independence invariant trivially; admission = the five gates as filed (gate 3 — every member already ruled, none in the decision box — and gate 5 — the named exclusion list — are load-bearing); fold-or-serial is a mandatory question whenever 2+ queued cards share a hot file, with the maintainer's verbatim 「你自己定的工作方式你也会忘。」 in the clause; the folded-claim conventions (shared branch named in every member claim, per-card commits, multi-Fixes PR body, lead claim carries the serial-constraints check) land in the claim protocol, written from this dispatch's own record. |

### Ratchet economics — one coherent pass funds all five additions

| file | before | after | ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 682 | **682** | 682 (headroom 0) |
| `references/seat-post-protocol.md` | 101 | 101 | 101 |
| `references/lanes/engine.md` | new | 41 | 41 |
| `references/lanes/services.md` | new | 31 | 31 |
| `references/lanes/cli.md` | new | 37 | 37 |
| `references/lanes/devx.md` | new | 38 | 38 |
| `references/lanes/skills.md` | new | 36 | 36 |
| `references/lanes/spec.md` | new | 44 | 44 |

Payments, all genuine dedup/relocation — no re-wrap of existing content: table 5 rows → 2 (-3); spec intra-seat reference relocated to `lanes/spec.md` (-8 incl. its stale sentence); the spec-only fixture-triage dispatch rule relocated to `lanes/spec.md` as its home (-3); the platform-readings TOC enumeration and the ccusage tool description collapse to pointers at the facts table that already carries them, verified against its actual headings (-2); the seat-post migration detail defers to `seat-post-protocol.md` (-1). Additions: request-card clause (+5), family-dispatch clause (+8 at the file's native line density — new text, not re-wrapped existing text), lane-file pointer in 座位贴协议 (+2), foreign-gate rule (+0, extends the `pm:blocked` table row, which is a single line by markdown table syntax). One extension rides an existing claim-protocol line (folded-claim conventions appended where the branch-naming rule already lives).

### Gates — union run at head 7371c47c5, after the final commit

Derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (no paths — script took the changeset from merge-base): 9 matched families. All green, exit codes captured before any pipe:

### Notes for the merging maintainer

- **Seat work after merge (recorded on the lead card, not this PR's):** label rename engine-core → engine (measured: no leftover `domain:engine` label object exists, get_label 404 — the rename path is clear), 44-card migration, seat-post consolidation + per-seat 4-section shrink, `bash scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` rerun.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` self-test fixtures use the literal `domain:engine-core` as an arbitrary label string; they assert nothing about the lane vocabulary and were left untouched (judged inert, reported here).
- One migrated-prose conflict was resolved in SKILL.md's favor: the devx seat post records flipping governed ADR PRs ready-for-review so the merge button works, while SKILL.md's ACCEPT-path fork says such PRs are never flipped ready. The devx lane file follows SKILL.md (恒 draft、留维护者); flagged in the dev report for the skills seat to reconcile.
- `skip-changeset` applied: the diff is `.claude/skills/**` + `scripts/pm/**` only — nothing published.
